analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sporting drew 2-2 at Real Sociedad II on Saturday, but Álex Corredera, who scored their penalty, was sent off for a second yellow and misses this game. Las Palmas had won three league games in a row, two of them under Albert Sánchez, who took over on 29 October, before visiting Granada on Sunday; Viti Rozada and Clemente are injured and Sandro Ramírez has a minor injury.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. I still lean slightly higher: Sporting's recent league games have averaged around three goals, including the 2-2 at Zubieta, and Las Palmas under Sánchez play an open, possession-based attacking game led by Jesé.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. I lean higher: Sporting had 63 per cent of the ball and 20 shots in their last home game, the kind of pressure that piles up corners, and Las Palmas like to keep the ball too.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. I have moved from same to higher: Sporting took three yellows and a red at Zubieta, and Las Palmas collect cards steadily by LaLiga's figures, so under five looks low.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.6 shots. I lean higher: Sporting took 20 on their own against Valladolid at El Molinón, and both teams have played open games lately.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target and I keep it. Sporting's volume has not always turned into accuracy, and they lose Corredera's goals from midfield.
